frase_gancho.texto: Artisan hands that shape clay, copper, and wood beside the sacred lake.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Step into Purépecha territory, a region defined by its forested valleys, volcanic plateaus, and the serene waters of Lake Pátzcuaro. This hall pays tribute to the technical mastery and community organization that characterize the daily life of the people of Michoacán. As you move through the space, you will discover re-creations of the traditional wooden granaries, along with examples of glazed pottery, hammered copper, and wool textiles. The exhibition highlights the dedication of the festival sponsors at patron saint celebrations, the cult of the dead, and the passing down across generations of traditional crafts that reaffirm identity.
